issues: Recurrent console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' from Recharts ResponsiveContainer — likely a hidden/collapsed chart parent without minWidth/minHeight. Not blocking, but noisy. Applies to WA page charts.

critical_code_review_comments: SafetyTab uses .catch(() => setS({})) which silently swallows errors — consider surfacing a toast on load failure so users know settings couldn't be loaded.

Recharts ResponsiveContainer warnings on WhatsApp page indicate a chart is being rendered in a hidden/zero-size container (probably a tab not visible on mount). Add explicit min height/width or defer chart mount until tab active.
